Hi Dylan,

Hope you’re well. We’re starting internal planning for our Redwood contract renewal and want to kick off coordination on capacity, commit terms, and the QBR schedule. Over the past 12 months our token volumes have grown ~2.0x during peak hours and we expect sustained growth as we onboard two pilot products in Q4.

High-level asks:
- Discuss a 2x committed throughput option (and short-term burst)
- Review term options; we’re open to a 12→24 month commitment if unit economics improve
- Schedule a renewal QBR the week of Aug 22 to align execs / procurement

Cc’ing our procurement lead Michael Chang to loop him in on timelines and any contract checkpoints. I’ve attached a short capacity forecast for context (Stellar_capacity_forecast.xlsx).

Can you propose an internal stakeholder list and a few times that week for a 60–75 minute kickoff?

Thanks,

Head of Platform Integrations
Stellar Health

- SLA exceptions: standard enterprise playbook attached; typical turnaround for security review is 2–3 weeks once SOC2 report and network diagrams are provided.

3) Marissa will schedule follow-ups and a QBR cadence (monthly or quarterly as you prefer).

Appreciate the quick turnaround — looking forward to aligning.
